text_block_list.text:
To ensure Inari One's feelings for Ohi 
wouldn't go to waste, her Trainer met with 
the Boss to explain her true intentions 
behind running in the regionals and what 
she was aiming for.

The boss then visited Tracen Academy, 
expressing his displeasure that Inari One 
hadn't declared to them her intention to 
aim for the "top" of the local circuits.

And he fired her up to stand tall and 
proud, not flinching from a brawl to take 
the "top."

Inari One declared that she would claim 
the top spot of the regional circuit. 
Having cleared up the misunderstanding 
with the Boss, she was ready to face 
everyone at Ohi head-on.
